description:
Edit a LinkedIn/X article, or record that it was published. After the user pastes the article into LinkedIn/X, call this with `publishedUrl` — setting it marks the article published (feeds the AI-visibility probe and the teaser post). bodyHtml allows only h2, h3, p, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, a, br; keep image placeholders as

. coverImage swaps the cover for a brand asset (null clears it); inlineImages replaces the full inline list and every marker must exist as a placeholder in bodyHtml. Editing is free. Empty image slots can be filled with a brand asset here, or generated with generate_social_article_image(s).

bodyHtml.description:
Allowed tags only: h2, h3, p, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, a, br. Keep image placeholders as

. Anything else is stripped.

assetId.description: Id of an image asset in this brand's library (list_assets); the URL is resolved server-side. Null/omitted keeps the existing slot (only alt/caption change), so empty slots stay empty.

prompt.description: Generation prompt stored for this slot (blank = keep the stored one).

coverImage.description: Swap the cover for a brand asset; null clears it. Empty slots are kept as-is.

inlineImages.description:
Replaces the full inline image list. Every marker must exist as

in bodyHtml.

publishedUrl.description: Live URL after pasting the article into LinkedIn / X. Setting it marks the article published.

teaserPost.description: Companion post to share the article. On X articles this is the caption posted with the article (max 256 characters, plain text).

name: update_social_article
